what.text: People from Ukraine were forcibly displaced internally and across international borders.
In 2025, there were 5224131 refugees from Ukraine recorded globally.
In 2025, the largest host country was Germany with 1173192 refugees, followed by Poland with 972287 refugees.

why.text: Conflict episodes in 2014 include Government of Ukraine vs Maidan, Government of Ukraine vs DPR (Donetsk), and Government of Ukraine vs LPR (Lugansk).
Between 2014 and 2022, conflict was recorded involving Government of Ukraine vs DPR, LPR (Novorossiya).
Between 2022 and 2025, conflict was recorded between Government of Russia (Soviet Union) and Government of Ukraine (Crimea).

when.text: Refugee totals were 5154 in 2013, standing at 237617 in 2014 and 321399 in 2015.
After standing at 27562 in 2021, refugee figures reached 5684177 in 2022 and peaked at 5960362 in 2023.
In the same timeframe, new internal conflict displacement movements reached 16870323 in 2022.

how.text: In 2025, UNHCR reported 3712000 internally displaced people within Ukraine.
IDMC reported 3712000 internally displaced people from conflict at the end of 2025.
Regarding specific transit routes or conditions of movement, the sources don't say.
